text: Any dispute, claim, or controversy arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall be resolved by binding arbitration administered by the American Arbitration Association in Chicago, Illinois. Each party waives any right to a jury trial or to participate in a class action. Customer shall bear its own attorneys' fees and one-half of the arbitration costs, except as otherwise awarded by the arbitrator.
